value.rationale: The four-point Boolean diamond is the first non-chain finite lattice and first finite lattice with a genuine branch-and-rejoin information geometry. A complete census of its admissible Fischer--Servi S4 relations, plus symmetry classes and endpoint stratum, is a naturally posed finite semantic invariant and a reproducible benchmark for modal-model constructions beyond purely linear or forked information orders.
